comment: Copy this file to config.json and customize for your environment

forge.comment: type: gerrit | github | gitlab. base_url: API base (e.g. https://api.github.com for GitHub). token_env: env var holding the API token. username_env: (Gerrit only) env var holding your Gerrit username — when set, token_env is used as the HTTP password and Basic auth is used instead of Bearer. repo_base_path: local directory where repos are cloned (default /opt/stack for DevStack).

devstack.comment: DevStack configuration. test_in_devstack enables deploying and testing changes in DevStack. cleanup_on_failure removes test resources even if tests fail.

output.comment: Where to save review documents. Can use ~ for home directory.

gerrit.comment: Gerrit server configuration. Usually doesn't need to change.

comment_testing: test_commands: list of commands Python runs before the AI review. Each entry: name (display label), cmd (command as list), timeout (seconds). max_diff_lines: lines of git diff to include in prompt (AI can Read files for more).

filters.comment2: Cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD) - ignore changes created before this date. Defaults to 30 days ago if null.
filters.comment3: Leave arrays empty to include/exclude no one
filters.comment4: Branch filtering. Wildcards (*) supported. Exclude processed first, then include. Examples: exclude=['*'] + include=['master'] = only master; exclude=['stable/*'] = skip all stable branches; exclude=[] + include=[] = all branches

notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and copy notifications.sample.json to notifications.json in the repo root

feedback.comment: post_to_forge: post review summaries and line comments back to the forge after each review. enable_voting: add a Code-Review vote (Gerrit) or APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES state (GitHub/GitLab). vote_label: Gerrit label name (default Code-Review). Scores: approval_score=+1 (no blocking issues), major_issues_score=-1 (critical/major issues found), minor_only_score=0 (only suggestions). Requires forge.token_env to be set.
feedback.comment_backport_voting: backport_voting: enable a separate Backport-Candidate Gerrit vote alongside the Code-Review vote (disabled by default). backport_vote_label: the Gerrit label to use (default: Backport-Candidate). backport_recommend_score: vote value when backport IS recommended (default: +1). When backport is NOT recommended the vote is always 0 (neutral). There is currently no separate score for the not-recommended case.

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes. rules_file is read-only (agents never write it).

comment_backport: backport_branches: branches changes may be backported to. backport_rules_file: path to a Markdown file containing backport policy rules (null = no rules file). triages_output_dir: where to look for local triage reports when assessing backport need.
